message.content:
I’m sorry I don’t have the ability to book rides myself.  
Here’s what you can do to schedule a “Plus” ride from your phone:

1. **Open the Uber App** – Make sure you’re logged into your account.  
2. **Set Your Pickup Location** – Tap the map pin icon or enter “Berkeley, CA 94704.”  
3. **Choose Ride Type** – Swipe up or tap the options bar; select “Plus” (or “Premium”).  
4. **Schedule a Future Trip** – Look for the clock‑icon button labeled “Schedule.”  
5. **Pick Time & Date** – Set the pickup time to “in 10 minutes” (you’ll see something like “Now + 10 min”) and confirm.  

If you prefer doing this via web:
- Go to [uber.com](https://www.uber.com) → Log in → Click “Ride” → Choose “Plus” → Schedule as above.

Once scheduled, you’ll receive a confirmation notification when the driver accepts the trip. If anything changes, you can cancel or reschedule through the same interface. Enjoy your ride!
